basic_info.description: Tastefully updated fully detached four bedroom single family home in convenient Excelsior location. The main level features a remodeled open floor-plan with spacious modern kitchen, formal dining room, inviting dining room, three bedrooms and two bathrooms all on the same level. Upper attic level can be used as a fourth bedroom or den/family room. Other highlights include level fenced rear yard with large deck. Garage parking with space for workshop and storage galore.  Great proximity to multiple schools, McLaren and Crocker Amazon parks and playgrounds. Easy access to public transportation, bicycle routes and the 101 & 280 freeways. Nearby vibrant Mission street commercial district is well known for a variety of restaurants and shops. Cute turn-key single family home.
